At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior – Audit Analytics**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As a Senior – Audit Analytics, you will support the delivery of data analytics solutions across Internal Audit, risk and controls engagements. You will work with large and complex enterprise datasets to develop, validate and visualize analytics that help identify risk indicators, control exceptions and process improvement opportunities.
  
  
The role requires strong hands-on analytical capabilities and the ability to translate audit and business requirements into scalable analytical solutions using technologies such as SQL, Python, Power BI, ETL tools and modern data platforms including Databricks and Snowflake. You will also have opportunities to contribute to technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation, including automation, Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), and AI/GenAI-enabled analytics.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Perform data extraction, transformation, profiling and analysis using SQL, Python and ETL tools/techniques.
* Develop and execute audit analytics, exception testing and risk-based analytical procedures across enterprise processes.
* Build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using Power BI to communicate analytical findings, exceptions and risk insights.
* Work with large and complex datasets across modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Perform data quality checks, reconciliations and validation to ensure the completeness and accuracy of analytical outputs.
* Translate audit, risk and business requirements into analytical logic, data requirements and test scenarios.
* Collaborate with Internal Audit, business, technology and data teams to understand processes, identify relevant data sources and deliver analytics.
* Document data logic, transformation steps, assumptions and analytical procedures to support repeatability and auditability.
* Support technology-enabled Internal Audit transformation initiatives, including analytics, automation and Continuous Controls Monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI/GenAI and Large Language Models (LLMs) within analytics, audit and risk management use cases.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong hands-on experience with SQL, including complex queries, joins, aggregations, data profiling and analytical logic.
* Strong hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, transformation, statistical modelling, automation and development of scalable analytical solutions.
* Strong understanding of ETL concepts, data transformation and working with data from multiple source systems.
* Hands-on experience developing dashboards and analytical reporting solutions using Power BI.
* Experience working with data warehousing and modern data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
* Strong data analysis, reconciliation and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with large and complex datasets.
* Ability to understand business, audit and risk requirements and translate them into structured analytical tests and actionable outputs.
* Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to explain analytical approaches and findings to business and audit stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI/GenAI solutions and Large Language Models (LLMs) and their application across analytics, audit and risk management.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multidisciplinary teams and manage assigned analytical deliverables.
* Understand common business and technology processes such as Procure-to-Pay (P2P/PTP), Order-to-Cash (O2C/OTC), Travel & Expense (T&E), ITGC and SOX controls.
* Have an understanding of risks, controls, KRIs and exception-based audit testing.
* Have exposure to enterprise systems and datasets such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, expense platforms, GRC tools or other ERP environments.
* Have experience or exposure to Internal Audit transformation initiatives involving analytics, automation or technology-enabled auditing.
* We are looking for a hands-on analytics professional who combines strong technical capabilities with an understanding of risk, controls and Internal Audit. You should be comfortable working with complex enterprise datasets, developing analytical solutions independently and translating technical findings into meaningful risk and business insights.
* You should bring a problem-solving mindset, strong attention to data quality and the ability to collaborate effectively with audit, business, data and technology stakeholders.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment:**
As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development:**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

We are trusted partners of KONE business lines and functions to develop, transform, manage and run their information technology solutions. We support KONE in its digital transformation journey by introducing e.g. digital cloud-based IT services, artificial intelligence (AI) and automation to support productivity, business growth and technological disruption.  Sustainability, curious mindset and innovation are at the core of everything we do, and this makes us an integral part of KONE’s success.
  
  
IT professionals - KONE Corporation
  
  
We are looking for a
  
  
**Principal Data Engineer, Data Products**
To join KONE IT Enterprise Data & Analytics team in Pune, India. The team is driving forward Data Foundation, new way of working with data using latest cloud technology. Data Foundation is key enabler in our digital transformation creating ability to develop new scalable analytics, AI and digital use cases by leveraging data across the whole organization. In our approach, data products play a vital role in business value generation. Driving optimized data engineering practices is crucial to ensure reusability and maintainability of the data products.
  
  
Principal Data Engineer leads the design, development, and industrialization of data pipelines to provide industrial grade data products for our data consumers. With the deep deep technical knowledge, Principal Data Engineer does hands on development of data products of significant complexity using applicable best practices. S/he acts as the go-to-person on the technical aspects for data product teams. S/he proactively identifies and drives the adoption of both new innovations and best practices for adopting these at an industrial scale to deliver optimized and high performing data pipelines.
  
  
Principal Data Engineer has strong communication skills to be able to translate the data requirements into technical requirements. S/he drives the delivery quality by ensuring appropriate development and quality practices are followed. Principal Data Engineer follows the technological progress, drives the definition of the common data engineering practises and ensures the best way of working by the teams. As subject matter expert in the discipline, s/he conducts trainings and provides guidance to others on data engineering practises, technology and/or development methods demonstrating strong communication, mentoring and coaching skill. Principal Data Engineer acts also as a people manager for experts within the discipline.
  
  
We are searching for an enthusiastic person to join the team who is excited about developing his/her own professional skills even further, learning new things and contributing to team success. We are expecting you to take a self-driven, proactive approach to your work, find & implement solutions, solve problems, and share the learnings to colleagues. We want to work with people who enjoy teamwork, are not afraid to step out of their comfort zone, want to help others and share information.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Designing data pipelines and doing hands-on data engineering development tasks in product teams. Understanding the business needs, data, methods for industrializing the data pipelines, their optimization and limitations.
* Demonstrating in-depth business domain-specific knowledge, ensuring that data pipelines are implemented with industry best practices, aligned with the design principles and architecture guardrails including planning and conducting quality actions, such as code reviews and triages in the teams.
* Maximizing reusability and usage of common design patterns across the data product teams with an aim to keep them lean and maintainable. Identifying technical debt regularly and ensuring that its management is prioritized in the product backlogs.
* Planning the production and support operations for data pipelines to be deployed for data consumers, troubleshooting and resolving incidents and identifying root causes and resolving them when needed. Identifying improvement opportunities based on the performance metrics and data consumer feedback.
* When agreed, takes additional responsibilities, such as leading organization wide capability development, engage with business stakeholders to provide data engineering and technology related advisory, representing KONE in internal and external forums such as technology forums, university collaboration etc.
* Team lead for Data Engineers.

**To succeed in Principal Data Engineer role, following professional experience will play a key role:**

* Master's or PhD degree in a quantitative field, for example computer science, sw engineering, statistics, mathematics, or data science/machine learning.
* Proven track record in applying data engineering practices to develop industrial grade reusable data products using cloud technology, industrializing data pipelines to production grade solutions and continuously improving them.
* 18-20 years of professional hands-on experience in data engineering and software engineering.
* Technical expertise in following tech stack: Databricks data engineering, Unity Catalog, Airflow, DBT, AWS Glue, AWS EMR, AWS Athena, Spark, Apache Flink, Apache Kafka, Terraform, Gitlab/Github. Databricks and AWS certifications preferred.
* Outstanding coding skills with multiple languages (Python, SQL, Scala) with proven hands-on experience in industry standard software development life cycle methods, DevSecOps/DataOps practices spanning the full data product/data pipeline lifecycle.
* Expertise in cybersecurity guidelines, data privacy, compliancy regulations and quality assurance practices, and cloud FinOps.
* Ability to write clear technical documentation and visualize your technical design.
* Practical experience in working with complex enterprise data landscapes and data structures (IoT and main enterprise systems such as SAP ERP, Salesforce, PDM, MES, etc.) and continuously optimize cloud costs.
* Experience in coaching and/or mentoring, leading teams, sharing knowledge and maturing DataOps practices.
* Passion to utilize agile development methodologies and tools (Jira, Confluence, draw.io).
* Ability to work in global multi-cultural team across different countries and effectively collaborate within the teams.
* Ability to self-organize and be proactive, seek feedback, be courageous and resilient, and have excellent problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in spoken and written English language, and strong facilitation and communication skills.

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

*https://careers.kone.com/en/*

title: Customer Success Engineer (SaaS) | Pune Onsite
description:
**About BotSpace**

BotSpace builds AI agents for e-commerce brands. They help brands sell more and handle customer support across their website, WhatsApp, Instagram and other channels. We work with fast-growing D2C and Shopify brands and are building an AI-native platform for sales, support and customer engagement.

**The role**

This is a customer role for an engineer. You'll own a group of BotSpace customers from the day they sign: get them live, learn how their business runs, find what stops them getting value from BotSpace and solve it. Sometimes that's configuration. Sometimes it's a script or an integration with the rest of their stack. Sometimes it's a bug you've narrowed down so well that our engineers can fix it the same day.

Elsewhere this job is called a forward-deployed engineer, implementation engineer or technical account manager. It isn't a pure development role: most of your week is spent with customers, and the code you write is in service of them.

**What you'll do**

* Onboard new brands: WhatsApp Business API setup, Meta verification and message templates, Shopify and other integrations, their first automations and their AI agent
* Own the relationship with your accounts on calls, WhatsApp and email, and review with them regularly what's working and what isn't
* Debug customer issues end to end: read the logs, check API responses and webhooks, reproduce the problem, then fix it or give engineering a bug report they can act on
* Build what a customer needs on top of the product: API and webhook integrations, small scripts, data imports, custom flows
* Notice early when an account is at risk, and when one is ready to do more with us
* Bring patterns back to the product team: repeat issues, missing features, rough edges in onboarding
* Write the docs and playbooks that help the next customer go live faster

**What we're looking for**

* A software engineer by training: B.E. or B.Tech in computer science or IT, MCA, or real hands-on coding experience
* 2 or more years in a customer-facing technical role at a software company: technical support, application support, implementation, solutions or customer success engineering
* You can read code and write some: JavaScript or Python scripts, REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, SQL or MongoDB queries
* You debug methodically and can explain what broke to a non-technical founder in plain words
* Clear spoken and written English, comfortable on calls with founders and operations teams
* You follow through. When a customer is waiting on something, they hear from you before they have to ask

**A major plus**

* Hands-on time with the WhatsApp Business API, Meta Business Manager or a messaging platform such as Gupshup, Twilio, Wati or Interakt
* Shopify: the admin, apps, webhooks and how D2C brands run their stores
* Helpdesk and CRM tools such as Freshdesk, Zendesk, Gorgias or HubSpot
* You've set up or tuned an LLM-based product: prompts, knowledge bases, AI agents
* A stint as a developer before you moved into support or implementation

**How success is measured**

* New customers go live quickly and actually use what they bought
* The accounts you own renew and grow
* Problems get fixed at the root, so the same issue doesn't come back
* Engineering can act on your bug reports without a follow-up call

**The pace**

This is a high-intensity, high-performance role. Our customers move fast, the targets are clear and you own the outcome. If that sounds good to you, you'll fit in well here.

**Why join BotSpace**

You'll sit between our customers and our engineering team and work closely with the founders. You'll see how hundreds of brands use the product day to day, and what you learn goes straight into what we build next.

**How to apply**

Apply on our careers site. It takes about twenty minutes: a short form with your resume and LinkedIn, then 4 quick questions with our hiring assistant. We read every application and reply within a week.

* 5+ years’ experience as a Senior DBA or Database automation Engineer; Expertise in designing/configuring mission critical, highly available and high throughput Databases

* A clear understanding of cloud service and deployment model

**Oil & Gas | Senior Manager**
**Job Title Principal Data Scientist – Senior Manager**
**Experience Level 15+ Years**
**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better. Join us and help build a better working world.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on Principal Data Scientist to solve complex modelling problems across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas. You will formulate operational challenges, establish defensible scientific approaches, develop critical modelling components, and define the evidence required for reliable deployment across wells, fields, equipment, process units, and sites.
  
  
**Role Details**
**Key responsibilities include**
:
  
  
**Scientific formulation and advanced modelling**

* Formulate operational problems as predictive, diagnostic, causal, or prescriptive tasks, defining targets, objective functions, constraints, decision variables, acceptance criteria, and evaluation methods.
* Assess data sufficiency, measurement quality, sampling bias, confounding, identifiability, and operating coverage to determine whether available evidence supports the intended outcome.
* Select statistical, machine learning, simulation, or hybrid approaches suited to noisy measurements, heterogeneous assets, sparse labels, rare events, censored histories, and distribution shifts.
* Apply probabilistic or hierarchical modelling, uncertainty quantification, survival analysis, semi-supervised learning, transfer learning, or domain adaptation where appropriate.
* Develop methods for multivariate forecasting, state estimation, change detection, degradation modelling, and industrial time-series analysis while distinguishing process dynamics from measurement artefacts.
* Combine learned models with engineering equations, mass and energy balances, simulation outputs, or physical constraints, evaluating accuracy, plausibility, extrapolation behaviour, and uncertainty propagation.
* Connect predictions with constrained optimization, assessing feasibility, sensitivity, robustness, and decision quality under uncertainty; design experiments or causal analyses when observational evidence is insufficient.

**Upstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for production forecasting, well surveillance, artificial-lift performance, drilling analytics, and production-system optimization.
* Separate the effects of reservoir behaviour, operating constraints, equipment condition, interventions, formation changes, and operating practices when interpreting performance.
* Collaborate with reservoir engineers and geoscientists on property prediction, uncertainty analysis, and simulation-assisted modelling.
* Determine whether models can transfer between wells or fields and define the data, recalibration, adaptation, and validation required.

**Downstream applications**

* Define modelling approaches for product-quality prediction, yield modelling, equipment degradation, blending, and process or energy optimization.
* Account for feedstock composition, throughput, catalyst age, equipment condition, process configuration, and control-system behaviour.
* Combine data-driven methods with engineering relationships, process simulations, and mass and energy balances.
* Connect predictive models with operating, planning, blending, or optimization workflows within defined physical and operational constraints, validating across feedstock changes, campaigns, grades, and configurations.

**Model assurance and generalization**

* Establish standards for baselining, benchmarking, feature-ablation studies, calibration, sensitivity analysis, robustness, and out-of-distribution evaluation.
* Challenge apparent improvements caused by leakage, weak baselines, inappropriate metrics, selective testing, or inadequate engineering interpretation.
* Distinguish models that reproduce historical associations from models capable of evaluating proposed operating changes.
* Define applicability limits, uncertainty treatment, monitoring requirements, fallback behaviour, and recalibration or retraining criteria.
* Assess predictive performance separately from recommendation feasibility and quality, and establish adaptation and validation strategies across assets, sites, configurations, and operating regimes.

**Technical leadership and scalable delivery**

* Remain hands-on in experiments, model development, prototyping, and troubleshooting.
* Resolve failures across data preparation, measurement quality, engineering assumptions, model formulation, software implementation, and production behaviour.
* Develop reusable modelling components, adaptation strategies, technical standards, and reference implementations; design reproducible experiments whose conclusions can be reviewed and defended.
* Evaluate emerging techniques through controlled comparisons with established methods and review production implementations for consistency with the intended scientific approach.
* Conduct scientific reviews, challenge modelling decisions, mentor Lead Data Scientists, and collaborate with engineering, data, ML engineering, and product teams to integrate validated models into operational workflows.

**Must Have Qualifications & Experience**

* A degree in a relevant engineering, scientific, or quantitative discipline.
* Substantial hands-on experience developing and deploying Oil & Gas analytical solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least one upstream or downstream area, with working knowledge across both segments.
* Advanced expertise in at least one relevant applied modelling specialization.
* Strong foundations in statistics, machine learning, mathematical modelling, industrial time series, scientific computing, experimental design, and uncertainty assessment.
* Strong Python and SQL skills, including scientific prototyping, implementation of critical modelling components, and review of production code.
* Experience integrating engineering knowledge into model formulation and validation, together with reproducible experimentation, production ML, model generalization, and deployment across varied operating conditions.
* Evidence of personally resolving a difficult methodological problem and establishing an approach adopted by others.
* Experience conducting technical reviews and guiding multidisciplinary data science teams.
* Ability to defend technical decisions using quantitative evidence and clearly communicate assumptions, trade-offs, limitations, and operational implications.

**Good to Have**

* Delivery experience across both upstream and downstream Oil & Gas.
* A master’s degree, PhD, or relevant applied research experience.
* Expertise in system identification, robust optimization, physics-informed learning, simulation surrogates, or uncertainty propagation.
* Experience with distributed scientific computing, scalable inference, cloud ML platforms, and production MLOps.
* Experience combining validated numerical models with knowledge graphs, specialized language models, or agentic decision-support workflows.
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or reusable technical assets demonstrating applied scientific contribution.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to solve high-impact modelling and decision-support challenges across upstream and downstream Oil & Gas operations.
* A role with hands-on technical authority, scientific leadership, and the opportunity to establish reusable methods and standards for multidisciplinary teams.
* A collaborative environment spanning domain engineering, data science, ML engineering, product, and global EY teams.
* Access to EY’s global network, technology ecosystem, and learning opportunities while contributing to a better working world.

**What We Look For**
A hands-on technical authority who can explain a difficult Oil & Gas problem they personally solved, why established approaches were insufficient, how the alternative was formulated and validated, where it can and cannot generalize, and how the resulting approach enabled other data scientists to deliver reliable solutions.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
